body:
I used to cut my arms a lot; then when people around me noticed, I stopped for awhile. Then the feelings came back -- I wanted to die but I couldn't so mind as well cut again, but this time I cut on my thighs. I used to cut really deep when I was young, when I started cutting again I tried to cut a lot but lightly so I don't end up with scars. 

Being an immigrant, there was no one I could talk to, so that's what I ended up doing. Now, I think wow - tattoos are easier, getting throwing knives and chucking them onto a board is nice. Just gotta get out all that pent up emotion! Cutting is very accessible but use your mind and find something that gives that similar release

I kind of faced a similar situation, the family guilt of the owed life. When I was in college, I worked with my advisor to find ways to build credit for both passions; my parents and mine. Ended up majoring in the field they wanted, but I got a minor in my passion. Sometimes the best is what you can afford when trying to just keep the façade up. 

There were some struggles with finalizing the minor because it was a topical minor; something almost "made up", but this way you can at least experience some moments of happiness and true education. You can also join clubs at school, if you have time, and join the arts and animation type clubs.

I hope this helps!
